title: Multiplicativity of the Jacobi symbol
statement: For every positive natural number $N$ and all residue classes $x,y$ modulo $N$, the Jacobi symbol, viewed as a residue class modulo $N$, is multiplicative: its value at $xy$ equals the product of its values at $x$ and $y$.
